raw_text: Niger's presidential guard has seized power in a coup d'etat, detaining democratically elected President Mohamed Bazoum. General Abdourahamane Tchiani, head of the presidential guard, appeared on national television declaring himself the new head of state. The military junta, calling itself the CNSP (National Council for the Safeguard of the Homeland), cited deteriorating security conditions as justification. ECOWAS has condemned the takeover and threatened sanctions. France, the former colonial power, has called for Bazoum's immediate release.
